weapons.name: Tank gun shell (direct fire)
weapons.note: The 720 m shell travel limit was supplied by the project owner and NOT confirmed by any page found (one third-party guide says 744 m). The official support page only confirms the 445 m spotting cap and the 565 m draw distance. Accuracy is quoted as dispersion at 100 m, not as a range.

weapons.name: SPG shell (indirect fire)
weapons.note: Per-shell maximum range is shown in game by coloured indicators (update 1.13 notes); no single fixed number found. Value is a class estimate.

default.note: No page found stating the default FOV; its default was not verified.

zoom.note: Newcomer's guide: highest zoom is x8 by default. FOV value not stated (0 = unknown).
Zoom can be raised up to x25 in game settings. FOV value not stated (0 = unknown).

fov.viewDistanceSource: https://wargaming.net/support/en/products/wot/article/10222 (565 m fixed draw distance; the 9.12 notes and community wiki say a 564 m radius circle)

sensors.name: Spotting range cap (all vehicles)
sensors.note: The maximum spotting range of all vehicles cannot exceed 445 m. Per-tank view range depends on turret, crew skills and equipment; no class table found, so none invented.

sensors.name: Draw distance
sensors.note: Other vehicles are drawn out to a fixed 565 m (564 m radius circle per the 9.12 notes).
